python_only_boundaries.csv_and_pandas: Pandas-backed arbitrary dynamic record schemas are a cold boundary; native fixed-schema CSV has its own unit gate.
python_only_boundaries.native_workers: Python Recorder is scalar. Native workers 1/2/8 are required here to produce identical full state/history payloads.
python_only_boundaries.reward: v_net_reward is covered only as an unchanged scalar carried by Solution/Recorder; no reward calculation or learning behavior is run.
python_only_boundaries.rl_and_training: save_summary RL/feature/training naming and solver integration are intentionally outside this non-ML differential; the native core only exposes a cold typed summary extension seam.
